scenes.title: Previously on The Producers
scenes.summary: A brief recap revisits Cindy camping in the rain, Ye-jin confessing her feelings to Joon-mo at the street tent, and Seung-chan learning the cash-only tent never took Joon-mo's credit card.
scenes.location: KBS broadcasting centre and street snack tent

scenes.title: An Accident Happens After Three Bad Coincidences
scenes.summary: When Seung-chan asks if he remembers Ye-jin's confession, Joon-mo recalls how three unlucky coincidences sparked that night's accident and how drunk Seung-chan refused to let them walk home alone.
scenes.location: street snack tent and Yeouido night street

scenes.title: Even When Edited Out, the Original Tape Remains
scenes.summary: Seung-chan calls Joon-mo cowardly for pretending he forgot Ye-jin's feelings because the original tape always remains, while Joon-mo warns him not to miss their editing deadline.

scenes.title: Did You Dump Syrup Straight Into My Coffee?
scenes.summary: Staging a petty rebellion in the editing booth, Seung-chan floods Joon-mo's coffee with syrup and calls his proud edit predictable and old-fashioned, leaving Joon-mo baffled.

scenes.title: Winning Someone Over With Home Cooking
scenes.summary: Over breakfast, Ye-joon advises Ye-jin to win a boyfriend over with home-cooked meals while Ye-jin shoots back that he should marry over spicy fish stew himself.

scenes.title: Liking Someone Is Nothing to Be Ashamed Of
scenes.summary: On the playground swings, Seung-chan tells a comforting white lie that Joon-mo blacked out completely, and Ye-jin shares how Joon-mo's apartment used to be her childhood family home.

scenes.title: If You Cry, More Reasons to Cry Follow
scenes.summary: Ye-jin recalls young Joon-mo painting her playground swing pink and repeating his grandmother's saying about tears, before Seung-chan reminds her she can always confide in him.

scenes.title: Did She Siphon Off Toner and Paper?
scenes.summary: Bursting into the editing suite after spotting the supply clerk in a luxury car, a colleague gossips nonstop until Ye-jin and Ji-yeon tease him for having a crush on her.

scenes.title: Who Will Escort All the VIP Guests?
scenes.summary: A colleague asks Ye-jin to direct the stage for his Family Month special concert because he plans to spend the entire event escorting VIP officials and the station president.

scenes.title: Stop Reading Between the Lines
scenes.summary: Reviewing twenty-two weekly schedules in the van, Cindy asks if 2 Days & 1 Night assistants join the KBS concert crew and tells her manager to stop misreading hidden meanings into her words.

scenes.title: Ten Thousand Won on the Premiere Ratings
scenes.summary: The 2 Days & 1 Night staff hold their traditional ten-thousand-won premiere ratings pool: Tae-ho bets a gloomy seven percent, Seung-chan calculates 6.8 percent, and Joon-mo boasts of great instincts.

scenes.title: The Jinx of the Variety Department
scenes.summary: Ji-yeon explains Joon-mo's famous jinx—every star or song he predicts will fail becomes a smash hit and vice versa—while Seung-chan whispers that he already noticed Joon-mo's poor instincts.
scenes.location: KBS interview room and audition flashbacks

scenes.title: Stuffed Cucumber Kimchi From the Eldest Son
scenes.summary: Seung-chan's older brother arrives at the Baek home with cucumber kimchi, and Jum-soon immediately suspects he got kicked out after another quarrel with his wife.

scenes.title: I Am One of the Kids Following Behind
scenes.summary: Gathering the family to watch the 2 Days & 1 Night premiere, Bo-sun brags his son runs the show, Seung-chan admits he is an assistant following behind, and Bo-sun pitches filming at a urology clinic.

scenes.title: Have You Ever Tied Your Mother's Shoelaces?
scenes.summary: Spotting Seung-chan tying Cindy's shoelaces on national television, Jum-soon indignantly asks if he ever tied his mother's laces, and Seung-chan replies she only wears laceless health shoes.

scenes.title: The Caption Just Aired Wrong!
scenes.summary: Watching the broadcast together, Ye-jin catches an on-air caption placing Goryeong County in the wrong province, then learns from Joon-mo's mother that Joon-mo skipped his prosecutor date.

scenes.title: The Station Ghost Covered Everyone's Eyes
scenes.summary: Reading furious viewer comments after the caption blunder, Ye-jin recalls the legend of the broadcasting-station ghost blinding editors during checks while Joon-mo dreads facing work tomorrow.

scenes.title: Why Are You Drawing a Line With Me?
scenes.summary: Over patio beers, Joon-mo lies that he met the pretty prosecutor to keep things comfortable between them; catching the lie, Ye-jin realizes he heard her confession and angrily calls it an accident.

scenes.title: You Should Set Up a Fortune-Teller's Mat
scenes.summary: When premiere ratings land on 6.8 percent, Seung-chan sweeps the office pool and earns a reputation as a ratings oracle right before Joon-mo is summoned to the director's office.

scenes.title: A Fortune Reading at the Supply Desk
scenes.summary: Handing Seung-chan extra printer paper after praising his television appearance, the supply clerk shyly asks if he senses anything about her romantic fortune.

scenes.title: Which Do You Want to Be Scolded For First?
scenes.summary: Director In-pyo chews Joon-mo out for mislabeling Goryeong County—briefly confusing the province himself until Tae-ho corrects him—before revealing Goryeong is the KBS president's hometown.

scenes.title: I Have to Write an Incident Report
scenes.summary: Staying behind after hours, Joon-mo drafts an official incident report chronicling how exhaustion, coffee, and a flickering editing-room light combined to cause the caption error.
scenes.location: KBS variety department office at night

scenes.title: I Guess I Am Only Comfortable as a Friend
scenes.summary: Treating Ye-jin to grilled beef, Seung-chan apologizes for hiding that Joon-mo remembered her confession, and when Ye-jin sighs she is only a comfortable buddy and not pretty, Seung-chan says she is pretty too.

scenes.title: Looking for a Short-Term Two-Room Lease
scenes.summary: Ye-joon tips Joon-mo off that Ye-jin asked him to find a short-term two-room rental, sparking an argument when Ye-jin insists moving out is how she will clean up her mistake.

scenes.title: Today You Are in Charge of Artist Standby
scenes.summary: At the concert hall before rehearsal, Ye-jin puts Seung-chan in charge of artist standby cues and microphones while brushing off a colleague's VIP escort updates and lunch invite.

scenes.title: The Burden of a Good Celebrity Image
scenes.summary: Backstage before rehearsal, a famously polite singer greets Cindy, envies her freedom to get openly grumpy, and describes blowing off steam through charity donation battles.

scenes.title: Even the Youngest Producer Would Be Fine
scenes.summary: Learning her manager turned away assistant producers, Cindy surprises Ye-jin in the dressing room by asking for the youngest producer to guide her stage blocking instead.

scenes.title: That Is Not the Title of the Song
scenes.summary: After Seung-chan innocently mistakes a hit singer for a drama-only actor, Ye-jin brags about loving his songs while getting every single song title wrong until Seung-chan corrects her.

scenes.title: The Producer Is More Scared Than the Singer
scenes.summary: Still dazed after seeing Cindy smile brightly, Seung-chan steps onto the shaky hydraulic stage lift to test it for her and clings to the rail as Cindy teases him for being more scared than she is.

scenes.title: Special Cafeteria Black-Bean Noodles Again
scenes.summary: Stuffed right after eating black-bean noodles, Tae-ho and a colleague run into Director In-pyo, and Tae-ho smoothly volunteers to guard the stage so his bloated colleague must eat a second bowl.

scenes.title: I Am a Patient Too!
scenes.summary: Pushing distracted Cindy clear of a moving stage platform sends both women to the emergency room, where injured Ye-jin fumes to breathless Joon-mo and Seung-chan that doctors rushed to Cindy first.
scenes.location: KBS concert stage and hospital emergency room

scenes.title: Trying to Prevent an Accident
scenes.summary: While a panicked colleague begs classmates to take over stage directing, Tae-ho explains to In-pyo that Ye-jin hurt her own arm trying to save Cindy from the sliding stage.

scenes.title: Dodging Cindy's Fan Club in the Hallway
scenes.summary: Outside Cindy's hospital room, Joon-mo and Seung-chan deny knowing who pushed Cindy on stage when fan-club members recognize Seung-chan from TV.

scenes.title: My First Real Rest in Ages
scenes.summary: Visiting Cindy's hospital bed with her arm in a cast, Ye-jin apologizes from the heart, and Cindy surprises everyone by thanking her for the first three-hour sleep she has had in ages.

scenes.title: Forcing a Patient to Work Is Coercion
scenes.summary: When CEO Byun rudely silences Ye-jin and orders hospitalized Cindy to fly abroad for a corporate event, Seung-chan calmly warns Byun that pressuring a diagnosed patient over money borders on criminal coercion.

scenes.title: Wrapping Up the Special Concert
scenes.summary: Back at KBS, the special concert wraps up smoothly and performers thank Seung-chan and the crew backstage.

scenes.title: Please Let Me Sit Alone for a Moment
scenes.summary: Finding tearful Ye-jin outside the hospital blaming herself for hurting Cindy and burdening him, Joon-mo checks her cast and pulls her into a quiet embrace.

scenes.title: Remembering Every Staff Member's Name
scenes.summary: In the epilogue, a guest singer struggles backstage to memorize every staff member's name on cue, greeting rookie Seung-chan before mixing up a writer's name.
